rule: For each criterion, take the median of the parent's initial score and two fresh-context blinded scores; sum the five medians.
blinding: Independent reviewers were spawned with fork_turns=none and given only the rubric and image paths. They were instructed not to read model identity, runtime logs, parent scores or other reviews.
discard_reason: These initial helper contexts inherited conversation history; they were interrupted before their scores were used. Their outputs are excluded from aggregation.
scope: Judgment-based reference fidelity of this one artifact. Review spread is not a statistical confidence interval or a model-wide benchmark estimate.
criteria_timing: The rubric was authored after generation, before numeric scoring. It was not preregistered before model generation.
